title: Road Rager Thinks He Can Flash Gun At People Without Consequences
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On August 27th, 2023. Officers were called to the airport about a man who flashed his gun at an uber driver on his way to the airport. The man stated that the Uber driver had cut him off and stopped his car in front of him and said he didn't know what the Uber driver's intention was, resulting in him flashing his gun at him for his "safety". The road rager kept trying to prove his innocence to the Police and kept claiming he feared for his safety and asked "what he was supposed to do" in that situation. This is the body-cam footage of the events.
